title: Geographic Story Builder
subtitle: Create and view interactive map-based biographies.
narrative: This app lets you explore pre-made geographic biographies (map + timeline + story cards) or generate your own. Enter a famous person's name or a short story outline below; an AI will produce a biography in the same format (locations, years, and narrative). You can then view it on the map and save the story as a JSON file.

cards.body: Explore the journey of Mahatma Gandhi across India, South Africa, and Britain.
